'''2008 Worlds Team Dan Tartaglione DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dan Tartaglione]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Dan Tartaglione]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
